## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the platforms affected.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:agent`
- [ ] Rust formatting and tests
- [ ] Platform-specific smoke test, when applicable
- [ ] Screenshots for material UI changes

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, personal paths, or process dumps are included
- [ ] New probes remain local-only and time-bounded
- [ ] Missing sensors remain explicitly unavailable
